title: Iowa: Trump headlines campaign rally at Sioux Gateway Airport, energizing GOP voter turnout ahead of midterms
text:
(Photos by Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images) Sioux Gateway Airport on October 22, 2026 in Sioux City, Iowa. OAN Staff Brooke Mallory
7:30 PM – Thursday, October 22, 2026
President Donald Trump headlined a boisterous campaign rally in Iowa, energizing key Republican voter turnouts ahead of the pivotal midterm elections.
Iowa Patriots wave as @POTUS touches down in Sioux City — SEE YOU SOON! ❤️ pic.twitter.com/AcVzPYHQe1
— Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47) October 22, 2026 Speaking before an enthusiastic crowd, the president delivered a sharp, wide-ranging address focused on bolstering local GOP candidates and reinforcing his administration’s signature platform.
The event highlighted Iowa’s critical role in the upcoming battle for congressional control, as conservative leadership seeks to secure vulnerable House and Senate seats amid an increasingly competitive nationwide environment.
Taking the stage to roaring applause, President Trump rallied behind Republican candidates — notably featuring Senate hopeful Representative Ashley Hinson — as he emphasized economic policy, domestic manufacturing and agricultural protections.
Ashley Hinson reminds Iowa voters how extreme Josh Turek really is: "He wants illegal immigrants to have those benefits. He wants asylum in this country… There's never a good time to elect a tax-and-spend liberal to the U.S. Senate. Now would be the worst time." pic.twitter.com/B3A2OpzOwA
— Team Trump (Text TRUMP to 88022) (@TeamTrump) October 23, 2026 Iowa Republican Gubernatorial candidate @ZachLahn vows to protect and defend Iowa's culture as governor: "My promise to you is I'm going to defend the culture of this state and defend your children and your grandchildren against this craziness." pic.twitter.com/apiyommNor
— Team Trump (Text TRUMP to 88022) (@TeamTrump) October 23, 2026 Throughout his speech, Trump urged supporters to turn out in record numbers, warning that crucial economic gains and trade policy victories would be placed at risk if Democrats were to gain ground in Congress.
He repeatedly touted his administration’s approach to international trade deals and tariff enforcement while promising continued economic relief for Midwestern farmers and manufacturing communities.
Beyond economic measures, the rally also covered familiar campaign themes, including border security, law enforcement support and his many criticisms of the “Dumbo-crat” (Democrat) Party.
Similar to past rallies, Trump brushed off minor hecklers during the event, using the interruptions to applaud local law enforcement and reiterate his law-and-order stance. Overall, the event served as a major momentum boost for the state’s Republican political apparatus, sending a strong signal that Iowa remains a central battleground in shaping the nation’s political trajectory.
TRUMP: Announces Iowa rally campaigning for Ashley Hinson, Zach Lahn, Brenna Bird, Mariannette Miller-Meeks, Joe Mitchell, Zach Nunn and Chris McGowan pic.twitter.com/iBkZtwFibq
— Trump Truths (@trumptruthsbot) October 22, 2026 Notable remarks made regarding Iowa GOP candidates:
Rep. Ashley Hinson: Trump strongly rallied support behind Representative Ashley Hinson, describing her bid as vital for maintaining conservative leadership. He emphasized her work on cutting taxes, creating economic opportunities and supporting Midwestern agricultural interests.
Rep. Zach Nunn: Trump highlighted Rep. Zach Nunn in his competitive reelection bid for Iowa’s 3 rd Congressional District, asking him to seek reelection to help Republicans protect their legislative agenda.
Rep. Randy Feenstra and Incumbents: Trump also praised House Republicans like Rep. Randy Feenstra, pointing to their alignment with his administration’s domestic manufacturing, as well as energy and trade policies. However, businessman and farmer Zach Lahn won the GOP primary and is now the Republican nominee running for Governor against Democrat Rob Sand.
General GOP Delegation: Lastly, Trump urged the audience to support the full slate of Iowa Republicans, warning that losing congressional seats would place conservative economic gains, agricultural protections and trade policy enforcement at risk.
President Trump announces $150 million under the Defense Production Act to expand U.S. refining capacity and increase domestic production of diesel and gasoline.
Watch OAN on OAN Live for updates. pic.twitter.com/QQQf3aewmN
— One America News (@OANN) October 23, 2026 President Trump touts tax cuts under the One Big Beautiful Bill, including provisions eliminating taxes on tips, overtime pay, and certain Social Security benefits.
Watch OAN on OAN Live for updates. pic.twitter.com/CX3zdi5lPu
— One America News (@OANN) October 23, 2026 President Trump criticizes Rep. Ilhan Omar over allegations involving her identity and past marriage, calling her response, “Not to my knowledge,” one of the worst answers he has heard.
For more updates, watch OAN on OAN Live or click the link in our bio. pic.twitter.com/8aBi7y638b
— One America News (@OANN) October 23, 2026 President Trump: "I assume she must immediately have to resign from Congress."
For more updates, watch OAN on OAN Live or click the link in our bio. pic.twitter.com/klgiBDawwt
